# Batter bowl: a mint bowl full of batter, a coral whisk handle sticking out. Up Z.
new
material new Bowl --base-color 0.6902 0.9216 0.5765 --no-slot
material new Batter --base-color 1.0000 0.9686 0.8941 --no-slot
material new Whisk --base-color 0.9765 0.5098 0.5176 --no-slot
add mesh cone --name Bowl --vertices 10 --radius1 0.2 --radius2 0.34 --depth 0.26 --location 0 0 0.13
material assign Bowl
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
material assign Batter
translate 0 0 -0.03
mode object
add mesh cube --name Whisk --size 1 --location 0.12 0.05 0.36
scale 0.07 0.07 0.42
apply --scale
set rotation 0 28 0
material assign Whisk
select all
shade flat
export bowl.glb
